<thought>Using the standard DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X)/2 (ignoring O and assuming no halogens), for C8H29O8N we have C=8, H=29, N=1, X=0. Plugging in: (2*8 + 2 + 1 - 29)/2 = (16 + 2 + 1 - 29)/2 = (-10)/2 = -5. The calculated DBE is -5, which as an integer is -5.</thought>
<final_answer>-5</final_answer>
